title: The Eternity of God
definition: The eternity of God means that God has no beginning and no end. He is everlasting, not bound by time, and remains the same throughout all generations.
summary: God existed before creation, rules over history, and will remain forever. Time does not limit Him. He sees the beginning and the end, and His purposes stand beyond every generation.
christFocus: Jesus shares in the eternal nature of God. He is the eternal Word who was with God and was God, and through Him believers receive eternal life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is eternal. He did not come into existence, He does not grow old, and He will never cease to be. He is the everlasting God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Everything in this world changes and passes away, but God remains. His eternal nature gives believers confidence that His promises, kingdom, and salvation are secure.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Trust the eternal God more than temporary circumstances. Live with eternity in view, knowing that your life, hope, and future are held by the God who never ends.
